name: service-cards
goal: Services use the Helpers card grid with only a class or service name and Used In links, preserving search and revision navigation on desktop, tablet and mobile

evidence: Services must match the existing helper grid, showing the class or service name and Used In links only. Search and both navigation targets retain revision scope across three viewports.

Existing catalog SSR coverage explicitly required service tables. The standardized card-grid browser matrix covered only components and helpers. Extended those existing cases to services and preserved consumer and revision navigation assertions.

Frozen test commit 95a9c9cc fails at the card-count assertion across desktop, tablet and mobile. Regression record e989c1d8a17a561d8a2469b25a6becf0d957e62baeb26386844f3209761441b3 preserves the failure. Before screenshots show the service table.

Reused the helper card and grid for services. Service rows use their owned class symbol or registered name, with up to three revision-scoped consumer links and page fallback. No new controls or styling.
